AUX_INPUT.note: BT/USB/codec auxiliary input; its samples arrive on a TDM slot this bench cannot drive

DCA.note: HOST-MANAGED since the 2026-08-30 ruling (D57) — the DSP applies no DCA gain, so there is nothing on the part for an audio probe to find

DELAY.note: per-strip delay line; probed at capture offset 0, where a delay is a step against silence

numeric.reason: float cascade; bit-exact bar is bqeverify.sh float vs bq_float_ref

FX_ENGINE.note: FX send engine; Type defaults to 0 = Echo, which the dispatch does not implement

GEQ.note: 28-band graphic EQ, one gain in dB per band

numeric.reason: float cascade; bit-exact bar is bqeverify.sh float vs bq_float_ref

meter.reading: neither reading matches, and a peak HOLD carries state from whatever ran before it — run mtrverify.sh for this family rather than reading a verdict out of this line

METER.note: read-only peak/rms/gr words; changes no sample, so its verdict is the readback against the capture

NOISE_GEN.note: generator: captured with the scope injecting nothing

TALKBACK.note: talkback injection node, fed from the codec return rather than the strip input
